gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns finite-time escape and the resulting failure of completeness of the characteristic flow under the standing C1 assumptions. ISSUE-001 instead diagnoses an incorrect unit-Jacobian and L^P-invariance calculation for an otherwise considered flow; it does not recognize the missing global existence/completeness obligation or the backward blow-up construction.

Both entries identify the same defect in the whole-space and moving-domain L^P norm lemmas: the characteristic displacement depends on the initial spatial point, so treating it as a constant and asserting a unit Jacobian is invalid for compressible flows. The supplied Jacobian formula, counterexample, and determinant-based repair directly cover the false invariance claim and its propagated norm-estimate consequences.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The proofs incorrectly use unchanged integration domains and a unit Jacobian to conclude exact L^P norm invariance, although the characteristic flow has a generally non-unit Jacobian determined by the velocity divergence. Correct change-of-variables factors or an explicit divergence-free assumption are required.

component_coverage.gold_component: The characteristic displacement depends on the spatial starting point, so the change of variables is not a translation with unit Jacobian and exact L^P invariance fails for general compressible flows, including the moving-domain version.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-001 explicitly states that the trajectory depends on the initial point, computes the non-unit flow Jacobian through divergence, gives a one-dimensional counterexample, identifies the invalid L^P conservation in both lemmas, and proposes determinant-weighted estimates or the divergence-free restriction.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue is that evaluating an arbitrary W in H(G) at a characteristic image may evaluate W outside G, so the bounded-domain functional is not well-defined and requires an extension such as zero extension. ISSUE-001 concerns the Jacobian and norm scaling of the characteristic change of variables; it does not identify the domain-of-definition obligation or supply the required extension.

The gold issue concerns the unsupported inference from L2 square integrability and literal support equality to strict compact support and membership in the printed H0 space. ISSUE-001 diagnoses a separate change-of-variables/Jacobian error in L^P norm conservation and does not recognize the support-containment or H0-definition obligation.
